title: सप्तत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 37 · Who is a fit recipient

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks whether a stranger, one long resident or one from afar is the better recipient. Bhishma says that those who act otherwise than virtuous conduct do not deserve honour, so one should always test men with care, and he warns of the arguer and the abuser, and ends with the rule for the householder in his actions.
summary.kn: ಹೊಸಬ, ಬಹುಕಾಲ ಇದ್ದವ, ದೂರದಿಂದ ಬಂದವ ಇವರಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾರು ಯೋಗ್ಯ ಪಾತ್ರರೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸದಾಚಾರವಿಲ್ಲದವರು ಸತ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಅರ್ಹರಲ್ಲ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಸದಾ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಬೇಕು, ವಾದಗಾರ, ನಿಂದಕರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಎಚ್ಚರ ಎಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि नवागन्तुक, चिरनिवासी या दूर से आया कौन उत्तम पात्र है। भीष्म कहते हैं कि सदाचार से भिन्न आचरण वाले सत्कार के योग्य नहीं, इसलिए सदा सावधानी से परखना चाहिए, और वे हेतुवादी तथा निन्दक से सावधान करते हैं।
summary.te: కొత్తవాడు, చాలాకాలంగా ఉన్నవాడు, దూరం నుండి వచ్చినవాడు వీరిలో ఎవరు యోగ్య పాత్రులని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. సదాచారం లేనివారు సత్కారానికి అర్హులు కారని, అందుకే ఎప్పుడూ పరీక్షించాలని, తర్కవాది, నిందకుల పట్ల జాగ్రత్తగా ఉండాలని భీష్ముడు అంటాడు.
summary.ta: புதியவர், நீண்டகாலத் தங்கியவர், தொலைவிலிருந்து வந்தவர் இவர்களில் யார் தகுந்த பாத்திரம் என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, நல்லொழுக்கத்துக்கு மாறாக நடப்பவர் உபசாரத்துக்கு உரியவரல்லர், எப்போதும் சோதிக்க வேண்டும், வாதிடுபவர், இகழ்பவரிடம் எச்சரிக்கை தேவை என்று பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: അപരിചിതൻ, ദീർഘകാലം താമസിക്കുന്നവൻ, ദൂരെനിന്ന് വന്നവൻ, ഇവരിൽ ആരാണ് മികച്ച സ്വീകർത്താവെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. സദാചാരമനുസരിച്ച് പെരുമാറാത്തവർ ആദരത്തിന് അർഹരല്ലെന്നും, അതിനാൽ മനുഷ്യരെ എപ്പോഴും ശ്രദ്ധയോടെ പരീക്ഷിക്കണമെന്നും ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു. തർക്കിക്കുന്നവനെയും ആക്ഷേപിക്കുന്നവനെയും കുറിച്ച് അദ്ദേഹം മുന്നറിയിപ്പു നൽകുന്നു; ഗൃഹസ്ഥന്റെ പ്രവൃത്തികളിലെ നിയമത്തോടെ അദ്ദേഹം അവസാനിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.37; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
अपूर्वं वा भवेत्पात्रमथ वापि चिरोषितम् ।
दूरादभ्यागतं वापि किं पात्रं स्यात्पितामह ॥

meaning.en: Grandfather, which is the proper recipient: one never met before, one who has long lived with us, or one who has come from afar?

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
क्रिया भवति केषांचिदुपांशुव्रतमुत्तमम् ।
यो यो याचेत यत्किंचित्सर्वं दद्याम इत्युत ॥

meaning.en: For some, the best practice is a quiet vow: to give whatever anyone asks, whatever it may be.

verses.text:
अपीडयन्भृत्यवर्गमित्येवमनुशुश्रुम ।
पीडयन्भृत्यवर्गं हि आत्मानमपकर्षति ॥

meaning.en: So we have heard, but only if it does not hurt one's dependents; for a man who hurts his dependents degrades himself.

verses.text:
अपूर्वं वापि यत्पात्रं यच्चापि स्याच्चिरोषितम् ।
दूरादभ्यागतं चापि तत्पात्रं च विदुर्बुधाः ॥

meaning.en: The wise hold that a recipient who is new, or one who has long stayed, or one who has come from far away, is a proper recipient if he is worthy.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
अपीडया च भृत्यानां धर्मस्याहिंसया तथा ।
पात्रं विद्याम तत्त्वेन यस्मै दत्तं न संतपेत् ॥

meaning.en: Then by not distressing dependents and by not harming dharma, let us know in truth the proper recipient, one to whom a gift given will cause no regret.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
ऋत्विक्पुरोहिताचार्याः शिष्याः संबन्धिबान्धवाः ।
सर्वे पूज्याश्च मान्याश्च श्रुतवृत्तोपसंहिताः ॥

meaning.en: Officiating priests, household priests, teachers, pupils, relatives by marriage and kinsmen are all to be honored and respected if they have learning and good conduct.

verses.text:
अतोऽन्यथा वर्तमानाः सर्वे नार्हन्ति सत्क्रियाम् ।
तस्मान्नित्यं परीक्षेत पुरुषान्प्रणिधाय वै ॥

meaning.en: Those who behave otherwise do not deserve respectful treatment. Therefore one should always test people carefully.

verses.text:
अक्रोधः सत्यवचनमहिंसा दम आर्जवम् ।
अद्रोहो नातिमानश्च ह्रीस्तितिक्षा तपः शमः ॥

meaning.en: Freedom from anger, truthful speech, non-violence, self-control, honesty, freedom from treachery, absence of excessive pride, modesty, patience, austerity and calm:

verses.text:
यस्मिन्नेतानि दृश्यन्ते न चाकार्याणि भारत ।
भावतो विनिविष्टानि तत्पात्रं मानमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: Bharata, the person in whom these are seen, genuinely rooted, and who does not do forbidden things, deserves honor as a recipient.

verses.text:
तथा चिरोषितं चापि संप्रत्यागतमेव च ।
अपूर्वं चैव पूर्वं च तत्पात्रं मानमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: So too, one long resident or newly arrived, one unfamiliar or familiar, who is such a recipient deserves honor.

verses.text:
अप्रामाण्यं च वेदानां शास्त्राणां चातिलङ्घनम् ।
सर्वत्र चानवस्थानमेतन्नाशनमात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Disregard for the Vedas, transgression of the scriptures, and instability everywhere: these destroy a man himself.

verses.text:
भवेत्पण्डितमानी यो ब्राह्मणो वेदनिन्दकः ।
आन्वीक्षिकीं तर्कविद्यामनुरक्तो निरर्थिकाम् ॥

meaning.en: A brahmin who thinks himself learned but reviles the Vedas, and who is devoted to the pointless science of logic and debate,

verses.text:
हेतुवादान्ब्रुवन्सत्सु विजेताहेतुवादिकः ।
आक्रोष्टा चातिवक्ता च ब्राह्मणानां सदैव हि ॥

meaning.en: who spouts arguments among the good, who wins by reasoning without a basis, who always abuses and out-talks brahmins,

verses.text:
सर्वाभिशङ्की मूढश्च बालः कटुकवागपि ।
बोद्धव्यस्तादृशस्तात नरश्वानं हि तं विदुः ॥

meaning.en: who suspects everyone, a fool, a childish and bitter-tongued man: know such a man, dear son. They call him a dog among men.

verses.text:
यथा श्वा भषितुं चैव हन्तुं चैवावसृज्यते ।
एवं संभाषणार्थाय सर्वशास्त्रवधाय च ।
अल्पश्रुताः कुतर्काश्च दृष्टाः स्पृष्टाः कुपण्डिताः ॥

meaning.en: As a dog is let loose to bark and to bite, so these men of little learning and perverse reasoning, seen and met as false scholars, are loosed for chatter and to destroy every scripture.

verses.text:
श्रुतिस्मृतीतिहासादिपुराणारण्यवेदिनः ।
अनुरुन्ध्याद्बहुज्ञांश्च सारज्ञांश्चैव पण्डितान् ॥

meaning.en: One should follow the wise who know the Shruti, Smriti, itihasa, puranas and forest texts, who know much and grasp the essence.

verses.text:
लोकयात्रा च द्रष्टव्या धर्मश्चात्महितानि च ।
एवं नरो वर्तमानः शाश्वतीरेधते समाः ॥

meaning.en: One should attend to the conduct of the world, to dharma, and to one's own good. A man who lives so thrives for endless years.

verses.text:
ऋणमुन्मुच्य देवानामृषीणां च तथैव च ।
पितॄणामथ विप्राणामतिथीनां च पञ्चमम् ॥

meaning.en: Having paid his debt to the gods, to the sages, to the ancestors, to brahmins, and fifthly to guests,

verses.text:
पर्यायेण विशुद्धेन सुनिर्णिक्तेन कर्मणा ।
एवं गृहस्थः कर्माणि कुर्वन्धर्मान्न हीयते ॥

meaning.en: in turn, by pure and well-cleansed action, a householder doing his duties in this way does not fall away from dharma.
